estilo: Photorealistic commercial photography for a professional engineering and maintenance company in Santiago, Chile. Technicians wear plain dark navy work uniforms with no logos and no text, with the correct safety gear for the trade. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no brand names on equipment.
movil: Composition: ONE single full-bleed photograph that fills the entire frame edge to edge.
